text:
Leila (CEO): Morning all — quick forward-looking snapshot and three asks for the next 2 weeks. High level: we need to lock down two priority bets that will define our Q3 roadmap and spending. TL;DR: 1) Finish Private EU GA rollout (compliance + scale), 2) Cut token/unit costs by 12–15% on high-throughput customers, 3) Harden failing canaries and incident response. Details below. :rocket:

Leila (CEO): Metrics to watch this sprint — 95p latency <= 140ms for hosted small-gen, average cost/token down 12% vs last month, error rate < 0.6% on production traffic. We hit parts of this but not all; the next 10 days are critical.

Leila (CEO): Ask 1 (Product & Eng): prioritize Private EU GA blockers. Marcus/Tao — freeze any non-GA feature work immediately. We need stability, compliance docs complete, and a final smoke test plan. Deliverable: GA checklist + signoff by legal by EOD day 7.

Marcus (VP Product): Noted. We'll move people off roadmap items 4 & 5. I'll post an updated backlog view by EOD today.

Tao (Head of Eng): Eng will reallocate two backend squads and one infra SRE pod to this. Plan: short canary in the eu-west-2 region, then cross-region failover test.

Leila (CEO): Ask 2 (Cost): Nora/Alex — validate cost reductions. Focus on batching, KV cache hit improvement, and quantized model paths. Target a clear roll-forward by day 10 with rollout knobs for Dedicated customers.

Nora (Head of Finance): We're modeling the 12–15% target and will share per-customer impact. Reminder: revenue-neutral efficiency work has priority for Q3 commit.

Alex (Platform PM): I'll surface specific config recipes for teams: suggested batch sizes, cache TTLs, and a recommended quantization profile per model family. Draft coming in this channel. :memo:

Leila (CEO): Ask 3 (Reliability): any canary failures from last week must have an owner and a 24h remediation plan. Tao — engage the postmortem and make sure we have automated rollback on the new router.

Tao (Head of Eng): Agreed. We found a KV-cache expiry edge that caused a tail-latency spike. Working fix is tested in staging; canary sched for 02:00 UTC tonight. Will share the postmortem link once written.

Leila (CEO): Other notes: hiring — short targeted pause on IC hiring for non-customer-facing roles for 3 weeks while we focus headcount on shipping GA and cost ops. Ivy, coordinate internal comms please. :eyes:

Ivy (People Ops): Will send a short note to managers and update the hiring tracker. Any exceptions, DM me.

Leila (CEO): Comms: we will not do a public launch announcement until Private EU GA signoff. Internally, customer-facing teams should prepare a single-page FAQ and an escalation path. Marcus/Alex please own the FAQ.

Marcus (VP Product): Will prep FAQ and a short playbook for AE/CS. Alex will attach the escalation contacts.

Alex (Platform PM): Draft FAQ + escalation matrix here: https://console.redwood.ai/internal/priority-bets/faq (internal only). Also adding runbook snippets for canary failures:```bash
/run canary --tag=eu-private-ga --timeout=30m
```

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance: eu-west-2 canary window 02:00-03:00 UTC — automated rollout will pause on >0.5% errors.

Marcus (VP Product): Quick Q — do we want a soft embargo on new Dedicated sales until the GA window closes?

Leila (CEO): Yes, soft embargo. Exceptions: strategic customers with legal in the loop. We'll handle on a case-by-case basis.

Tao (Head of Eng): One final ask — please surface any customer support threads referencing EU data residency or Private deployment issues. We need those to prioritize fixes.

Nora (Head of Finance): Also tracking the commit for reserved capacity revenue. Finance will need final numbers by day 12.

Leila (CEO): Thanks — quick cadence: daily 10m sync for leads at 09:30 UTC for the next 7 days, and a full readout next Friday. If you can't make the daily, post a 1-line update here. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Marcus (VP Product): Ack. I'll drop the backlog view and the FAQ draft by 18:00 PT.

Tao (Head of Eng): We'll post the canary results and the postmortem link in this thread.

Ivy (People Ops): Shared calendar invites for the daily syncs.

Leila (CEO): Appreciated — let's stay ruthless on scope for these two weeks. Small set of wins, big impact. :white_check_mark:

Marcus (VP Product): Thanks — rolling up sleeves. :muscle:

Tao (Head of Eng): On it.

Nora (Head of Finance): Thanks everyone.

Alex (Platform PM): ping me for any immediate infra config needs.

Leila (CEO): End of thread — will repost any major updates. :party_parrot:
